ruleDefinitions.name: Security Software Discovery Via Powershell Script
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects calls to "get-process" where the output is piped to a "where-object" filter to search for security solution processes.
Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of security software, configurations, defensive tools, and sensors that are installed on a system or in a cloud environment. This may include things such as firewall rules and anti-virus
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*get\\-process\\ \\|\\ \\?.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*get\\-process\\ \\|\\ where.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gps\\ \\|\\ \\?.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gps\\ \\|\\ where.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Company\\ \\-like.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Description\\ \\-like.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Name\\ \\-like.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Path\\ \\-like.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Product\\ \\-like.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*avira\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*carbonblack\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*cylance\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*defender\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*kaspersky\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*malware\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*sentinel\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*symantec\\*.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\*virus\\*.*")))
